evals.prompt: I have a markdown file at /tmp/test-notion-push.md that I want to push to Notion. The parent page ID is a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890. Create the page and update the local file with sync metadata.
evals.expected_output: Creates a Notion page via the markdown API, gets back the page ID and URL, then updates the local file's YAML frontmatter with notion_page_id, notion_url, notion_last_synced, and notion_parent_id fields.

assertions.text: Page was created successfully via POST /v1/pages with markdown parameter
Used Notion-Version: 2026-03-11 header (markdown API version)
Local file was updated with notion_page_id in YAML frontmatter
Local file was updated with notion_url in YAML frontmatter
Local file was updated with notion_last_synced timestamp in YAML frontmatter
YAML frontmatter stripped before sending to Notion
Used jq or python for proper JSON encoding of markdown content

evals.prompt: Pull the Notion page b2c3d4e5-f6a7-8901-bcde-f12345678901 to a local file at /tmp/pulled-from-notion.md. Include all the sync metadata in the frontmatter.
evals.expected_output: Retrieves the page markdown via GET /v1/pages/:id/markdown, checks for truncation and unknown blocks, writes the content to the local file with YAML frontmatter.

assertions.text: Used GET /v1/pages/:page_id/markdown endpoint
Used Notion-Version: 2026-03-11 header
Checked truncated field in response
Checked unknown_block_ids in response
Written file includes YAML frontmatter with notion_page_id
Written file includes notion_last_synced with ISO8601 timestamp
Written file includes the actual markdown content from Notion

evals.prompt: I have this markdown file at /tmp/test-validate.md - can you validate it for Notion compatibility and tell me if there are any issues?
evals.expected_output: Reads the file, checks for H5/H6 headings, unsupported blocks, tab indentation, multi-line quotes, and reports pass/warn/fail results.

assertions.text: Detected H5 heading and warned about H4 conversion
Detected H6 heading and warned about H4 conversion
Detected multiple separate > quote lines creating separate blocks
Detected space-indented list item instead of tab indentation
Detected or warned about the <unknown> bookmark block
Detected space-indented toggle children instead of tab-indented
Confirmed valid blocks pass validation
Provided a clear summary with pass/warn/fail counts

evals.prompt: Pull the Notion page b2c3d4e5-f6a7-8901-bcde-f12345678901 to /tmp/pulled-with-media.md and download all embedded media files locally so the URLs don't expire. Save them in an assets folder next to the markdown file.
evals.expected_output: Pulls the page markdown, then uses the media handler script to detect pre-signed S3 URLs, download media to assets/ directory, and rewrite markdown paths to local references.

assertions.text: Pulled page markdown via GET /v1/pages/:id/markdown
Detected pre-signed S3 URLs in the pulled content (or correctly reported none found)
Used the notion_media.py script or equivalent logic to handle media download
If media found: downloaded files to an assets/ directory relative to the markdown file
If media found: rewrote markdown image/media URLs to local relative paths
Written file includes YAML frontmatter with sync metadata

evals.prompt: I have a markdown file at /tmp/test-media-push/test-with-local-media.md that references a local image in assets/test-image.png. Push this to Notion under parent page a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890. Make sure the local image gets uploaded to Notion properly.
evals.expected_output: Detects local media references, uploads them via the File Upload API, resolves Notion-hosted URLs, replaces local paths, and pushes the full content.

assertions.text: Detected local image reference (assets/test-image.png) in the markdown
Used the File Upload API or notion_media.py script to upload the local image
Created the Notion page via POST /v1/pages with markdown parameter
Used Notion-Version: 2026-03-11 header
Local file was updated with notion_page_id in YAML frontmatter
Image was uploaded to Notion (either via file upload flow or noted the limitation)
